name: BN4's virus families in BN6's engine
now: In players' runs since 5 November 2026 (shipped in 0.20.0), installed wherever BN4's ROM is read (src/emu/xvirus.c's xvirus_install); since 12 November 2026 they come as an act's signature family and its partners in place of the one-in-four visitor (src/core/group_arc.c; docs/game/progression/encounter-groups.md, Step 3). As it was built: Billy (BN4 ids 13-18), Spikey (25-30) and Shrimpy (31-36) run as BN6 viruses from recipes tools/xrecipe_bn4.py derives from the two ROMs (src/emu/xvirus_bn4.c, AI 64-66, ids 0x2C0-0x2D1): their own states as BN6's 8-11, their calls paired through tools/bn4_twins.py (each compared by body, the differing ones audited), their init's flags as BN6's struct2's, what their init or update does past BN6's own work as hook 5 or 3 (a routine of their own, or a tail entered through a shim), Spikey's fireball and Shrimpy's bubble (the third kind's 0x30 and 0x2F) moved with them through the second-level dispatch at numbers apart from BN5's, their sprites copied. Installed at first with --dev bn4families; headless, foes 2C6@52 and 2CC@52 put them on the field, their attacks strike an idle MegaMan for 30 (V1) and the autopilot deletes each. Walla (ids 103-108, AI 67, 0x2D2-0x2D7), Elmperor (109-114, AI 68, 0x2D8-0x2DD) and CirKill (91-96, AI 69, 0x2DE-0x2E3) the same way: Walla's rings, Elmperor's strike and CirKill's shot (the third kind's 0x3C, 0x79, 0x0B) moved, CirKill's shot's kinds table copied with it; Elmperor's and CirKill's update's own work before their state run as their pre-step, BN6's dispatcher jumping into their update's copy; Elmperor's own deletion state wrapping BN6's. Headless, foes 2D2@52, 2D8@52 and 2DE@52 put each on the field, its attack strikes MegaMan for its record's damage (20, 30, 30) and each is deleted. Under --dev bn4families they visited runs' battles as BN5's families did (src/core/visitors.c: the nets' one battle in four from act 2, drawn by family, until the encounter groups; their roles and stages from BN4's records, the groups' first tag). Their effects each moved (none of BN6's draws its sprite's bytes): ids 0x90-0x99 of BN4's families' 0x90-0x9F, their sprites at list 5's 0x98 on or in list 4, Billy's first; the can-move check's panel type 0xA decided none of BN6's. Billy's thunder runs as a copy of BN6's own third-kind 0x2A (tools/xrecipe_bn4_copy.py, src/emu/xvirus_bn4_copy.c) whose init passes r3 = 0 as BN4's does, at the dispatch's 0x2A, BN6's own left as it is: billy_v1 compares 1200 fight frames, the family's own records the same in all of them (the world INCONCLUSIVE from t1). Their 12 sounds BN6 has no song of (Spikey's 0xBC and 0xC4, Shrimpy's 0x9F, 0xC9 and 0xCA, Walla's 0x70, 0x9A, 0xA6 and 0xB7, Elmperor's 0x9D and 0xFC, CirKill's 0xF9) are BN4's own: each song copied from the player's ROM as the family installs (xsong_pack, a room below the families' sprites), listed at a slot of BN6's empty songs fixed for it (0x3F down to 0x34, src/audio/xsong.c's XSOUNDS) on the player BN4's entry names, the code's movs given the slot; each proved by tools/mp2k_verify.py x1/N against BN4 playing it, and begun in the specs on BN4's player at BN4's frame (legit.json's bn4 sounds pair each by its routine). Their rewards are BN4's own: BN4's reward rows (BN4_REWARD_ROWS 0x080F5F50, 20 u16 an enemy id in BN6's format; the chooser 0x080F57DC and pick 0x080F580C BN6's by their bytes, a virus's row its id by 0x080F5EC4) read for each version's id at install and written into its ids' rows of BN6's grown copy, a chip as BN6's own of its name and kind else 200 zenny (xchips_reward_bn4; none of the six families' chips is BN6's). Proved in romlab: Billy busted at Busting LV 9, the pick took id 0x0D and its row and gave 0x1639 (Thunder1 L), BN4_BATTLE_REWARD the same; Billy's row recoded to 0x4123 gave 0x4123, the next id's recoded gave 0x1639 again. In BN6's engine (--dev bn4families, foes 2C0@52) Billy V1 busted at Busting LV 4 paid 30 zenny, its row's. BN4's Mettaur (ids 1-6, type 2) moved the same way for Roll's summon alone (the owner's call of 8 November 2026; AI 70, ids 0x2E4-0x2E9, in the families' second room: code from XV_CODE + 0x11000, art from XV_ART + 0x54000): its four generic wrappers (1, 2, 4, 5) its own, its appear queue (BN4_QUEUE_*, one queue) made BN6's queue 0 through r0 shims (XvSoundCall), its shockwave (the third kind's 0x16) moved with its kinds' table, its sound 0x8B played from Roll's per-battle pool (her slot 0xE0, SUMMONER_POOL), 0x41-0x4B left BN5's; XVirusFamily.summoned keeps it out of the nets' kin and the visitors, as BN6 has Mettaur by name. mettaur4_v1 PASSes over 1200 frames, four mutations caught.
left: Billy's family proven (billy_v1-v3 PASS, its three mutations caught). The five others' shared opening settled: the families' draws before the fight is seeded replayed from BN4's (Spikey's moves at its init, BN4_SPIKEY_MOVES 0x080BA5BC; Shrimpy's first way), the opening's idle animation ported (BN4's virus after-state BN4_VIRUS_PRESENT 0x08010736 updates its sprite through the paused opening, BN6's twin BN6_VIRUS_PRESENT 0x08016E64 skips it while paused) and BN6's opening run a frame longer in the comparison (legit.json's bn4 align, BN6_APPEAR_BLINK_FIRST: the engines' appear bit 0, 18 frames after a virus's init in BN4 and 17 in BN6), no allowance left there, a diagonal step's direction read as BN6's (its 5) and a pointer into BN4's moved code named by the moved blocks (CirKill's shot's record). Spikey V1-V3 and Shrimpy V1-V2: the family's own records the same in all 1200 frames, INCONCLUSIVE where MegaMan is struck (his +0 0x13 against BN6's 0x15: t277, t207, t170; t790, t222). Shrimpy V3 PASSES since (it failed at t65, its hook 0x080BA13E reading the idle animation's end a frame apart); all 18 BN4 specs PASS (2026-11-04). Left: a BN4 spec of two or more foes (the alignment refuses it: BN6's appear queue would take the frame on each foe's blink), Walla V1-V3 and CirKill V1-V3 on the hit's spark (t72/t68/t66, t32/t26/t23), Elmperor V1-V3 at t1 on its collision data +6 and +8; xdiff's reading of BN4's other moved types against BN4's own numbers; their sounds play as BN6's of the same numbers; Elmperor's panel types 8 and 0xA kept as BN4's numbers, its aura not drawn; the families' art room nearly full; BN4's other 11 families.
